title: 第二十一章 任务物品第二十二章 开局打野
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 解清玄只是敬这老道高她一小段的修为，还有那黄风岭长老的身份，这才耐心听完他一通哔哔。
她瞟了眼手焰溪长老中那满是杂质的藤木之晶，果断俯身行礼道歉：“抱歉，源述并无兴趣交换。”然后终于操起原主的高冷保护色，一溜烟遁入秘境之中。
“源述长老！唉！源述长老！”
解清玄身后焰溪施法追了两步，见周围一些好事的长老都扭过头来看向这边，只得冷哼一声悻悻作罢。
穿过光门时解清玄猛然想到：原著中这老道去为难男主，怕不是就是因为原主拒绝了他的交易请求吧！
“世界线归束！逻辑闭环了！”解清玄觉得蛮有趣的，原著中所写只是冰山一角，作者笔墨之外的地方也藏着许多因果。
进入光门，解清玄眼前又是一暗，光门的另一边也是一条幽暗深渊的洞穴甬道。
顺着笔直的甬道直行疾驰半分钟眼前终于豁然开朗，天地广阔看不到尽头，原野森林高山流水、各色地貌皆有，这秘境之中俨然是个生态完整的小世界。
头顶深空万里无云，深蓝天穹洒下明媚阳光，可这四方天地中却是哪里也看不到太阳。
此间指南针也指不了东南西北，只能指向秘境入口处的传送门。
幸亏解清玄提前做了预习，所以现在对着那不知是何人绘制的抽象派秘境地图也不至于太迷茫。
秘境的入口是随时变化的，解清玄花了一些时间对照周围的“地标式”地形弄清楚了自己的位置，然后快速规划好了自己的行动路线。
她有提前在地图上圈出叶问秋要她寻的天材地宝可能出现的地方。这清单上的东西有点杂，地点也较为分散，其中还有两种需要进入秘境内圈去取，危险性比较大。这外圈的东西她自是会尽力去拿全，但内圈的还是要量力而行，不能冒险。
于是解清玄的“清点”行动就按部就班地开始了。
第一日：蛇影潭取青金水蛇毒囊（11）难度：低，水灵晶（21）难度：低
第二日：野菇原采石晶菇（55）难度：低，寻筑基级别灵兽灵丹（23）难度：低
第三日：秃山取岩兔爪子（22）难度：中，筑基级别灵丹（33）
“果然以我这修为在秘境中外围还是可以横着走的！”
三日初探，解清玄的清单完成进度喜人，除了花些时间，其他没遇到什么难处。
她甚至还游刃有余顺手搭救了一把偶遇的同宗门小辈，稍微沐浴了一下后辈们崇拜的目光。
第四日：飓风渊内侧取风石之晶（22）难度：低，结丹级别灵兽丹（12）难度：中
解清玄胆子稍微大了一些，越过了作为秘境内外圈屏障的飓风渊，溜着边儿去取了一些任务物品。过程也是十分顺利，没有遇到任何危险。
在偶然斩杀了一只元婴初期级别的灵兽之后解清玄有些微微膨胀了。
她甚至开始想，那原主标记的【藤木之晶】她也未尝不可去试着一取啊……
content_en:
Xie Qingxuan only respected the old Taoist's cultivation level which was a little higher than hers, and the identity of the elder of Huang Fengling, so she patiently listened to his beeps.
She glanced at the vine crystal that was full of impurities in Elder Yanxi's hands, and decisively leaned over to salute and apologize: "Sorry, Yuan Shu is not interested in exchanging." Then she finally took on the cold and protective attitude of the original owner and fled into the secret realm.
"Elder Yuanshu! Alas! Elder Yuanshu!"
Behind Jie Qingxuan, Yan Xi cast a spell and chased for two steps. Seeing that some of the meddlesome elders around him turned their heads to look this way, he could only give up with a cold snort.
"Ah...!"
When he passed through the light door, Xie Qingxuan suddenly thought: In the original work, the old man went to embarrass the male protagonist, maybe it was because the original owner rejected his transaction request!
"The world line has ended! The logic is closed!" Xie Qingxuan found it quite interesting. What was written in the original work was just the tip of the iceberg, and there were many causes and effects hidden outside the author's words.
…
Entering the light gate, Xie Qingxuan saw darkness again. On the other side of the light gate was a cave passage with a dark abyss.
After driving straight along the straight corridor for half a minute, it suddenly dawned on me that the world was vast and there was no end in sight. There were wilderness, forests, mountains, flowing water, and various landforms. This secret realm seemed to be a small ecologically complete world.
The sky above our heads was cloudless, and the deep blue sky shed bright sunshine, but there was no sun anywhere in the four directions.
The compass here cannot point to the southeast, northwest, and can only point to the portal at the entrance to the secret realm.
Fortunately, Xie Qingxuan had previewed in advance, so he was not too confused now about the abstract secret map drawn by someone unknown.
The entrance to the secret realm changes at any time. Xie Qingxuan spent some time to figure out his position based on the surrounding "landmark" terrain, and then quickly planned his route of action.
She had circled on the map in advance the places where the treasures of heaven and earth that Ye Wenqiu wanted her to find might appear. The items on this list are a bit complicated, and the locations are relatively scattered. There are two types of items that require entering the secret inner circle to get them, which are relatively dangerous. She will try her best to get all the things in the outer circle, but she still has to do what she can within her ability and not take risks in the inner circle.
So Xie Qingxuan's "inventory" operation began step by step.
Day 1: Get the green gold water snake venom sac from Snake Shadow Pond (11) Difficulty: Low, Water Spirit Crystal (21) Difficulty: Low
Day Two: Collecting Stone Crystal Mushrooms in Wild Mushrooms (55) Difficulty: Low, looking for Foundation Level Spirit Beast Spirit Pill (23) Difficulty: Low
Day 3: Take the Rock Rabbit Paw from the Bald Mountain (22) Difficulty: Medium, Foundation-building Level Elixir (33)
"Sure enough, with my level of cultivation, I can still walk sideways in the outer reaches of the secret realm!"
After three days of initial exploration, Jie Qingxuan's list was completed at a satisfactory pace. Apart from spending some time, he did not encounter any difficulties.
She even managed to rescue a junior from the same sect whom she met by chance, and was given the admiring gaze of her juniors.
Day 4: Get the Wind Stone Crystal (22) from the inside of the Hurricane Abyss. Difficulty: Low, Dan-level Spirit Beast Pill (12) Difficulty: Medium
Xie Qingxuan became a little bolder and crossed the hurricane abyss, which was the barrier between the inner and outer circles of the secret, and slipped aside to pick up some mission items. The process was also very smooth and no danger was encountered.
After accidentally killing a spirit beast at the early stage of Nascent Soul, Jie Qingxuan felt a little swollen.
She even began to think that she might as well try to get the [Wine Crystal] marked by the original owner...
